_comment: Single source of truth for the software apps shipped by this monorepo. Consumed by scripts/build_site.py (GitHub Pages landing page + deploy copy list) and scripts/publish_portfolio.py (portfolio cards + Obsidian notes). `summary` is the one-line portfolio-card copy (HTML-ready, keep it under ~120 visible characters so cards stay even); `description` is the full copy shown in the card's Details view and the Obsidian note (HTML-ready); `desc` is the short landing-page blurb. Optional `portfolio_order` overrides `order` for the portfolio card sequence only (the lowest values are the featured cards shown first); `portfolio: false` keeps an app off the portfolio without changing the landing page or notes. `links` are relative to the deployed site root (https://juw12.github.io/projects/<rel>). Extra fields `image_alt`, `project_id`, `label` (thumbnail aria-label) and `desc` reproduce the live markup verbatim.

apps.name: Twin
apps.desc: TwinAgent research team, stocks from any country, multi-currency practice, lessons, Replay Lab and optional real trading
apps.description: Twin is an iPhone-ready investing and trading companion with a clean, professional design (1.5.1: new design system, line icons, dark and light themes) that updates itself the moment a new version ships (1.5.2). New in 1.5: TwinAgent, a free research team of five analysts (trend, SEC-filed fundamentals, risk, relevance-screened headlines, famous investors' 13Fs) that argue a bull and bear case from cited, dated evidence; a portfolio manager rates the stock and a risk gate built from your own limits sizes or blocks the idea. No AI subscription, the same evidence always gives the same report, future data is filtered out, and a walk-forward scorecard tests the price evidence over decades against buy-and-hold. Search stocks by company, ticker or country — Tokyo, Hong Kong, Jakarta, London, Frankfurt, Mumbai, Toronto, São Paulo, Sydney and more — with exchange, currency, market hours, ≈ USD price and US-listing hints on every stock page. World markets shows market clocks, 18 indices, movers and a heatmap; practice trades in a separate $10,000 USD portfolio convert foreign prices at delayed FX rates, and totals can be shown in your home currency (25 currencies). Continue as guest or share a ?guest link; market, limit, stop, stop-limit and trailing orders with brackets, price alerts, scrub charts with SMA/EMA/RSI, portfolio X-ray with country and currency exposure, a bar-by-bar Replay Lab and 12 Twin Academy lessons. The local server searches any Yahoo Finance listing; the web demo uses a dated snapshot of 54 global stocks on 25+ exchanges. Optional real trading through your own Alpaca account (US listings only) on the local server. Not financial advice.
apps.summary: Investing companion with a five-analyst AI research team, global stock search, paper trading and a replay lab.
apps.image_alt: Twin 1.5: redesigned Home, TwinAgent Buy verdict with evidence score, risk gate with practice-trade plan, and AAPL stock page
